context: A veteran actress shares advice with a young aspirant after rehearsal
purpose: Teach: 演劇/女優/主演/演じ/フィルム/台詞/パーティー/エピソード

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お疲れさま。あなた、本当に演劇が好きなのね。稽古中の目が違うわ。
lines.en: Good work today. You really love theater, don't you. Your eyes are different during rehearsal.
lines.style: Warm grandmotherly tone, gentle observational praise with reflective pause.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。先生みたいなベテラン女優になるのが夢なんです。
lines.en: Thank you so much. My dream is to become a veteran actress like you, sensei.
lines.style: Bright eager teen voice, slightly shy but full of admiration.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 嬉しいこと言ってくれるわね。私も若い頃、初めて主演を務めた時は震えたものよ。
lines.en: What a sweet thing to say. When I was young and first played the lead, I trembled too.
lines.style: Nostalgic and soft, with a knowing chuckle and slower pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 信じられません。あんなに堂々と役を演じていらっしゃるのに。
lines.en: I can't believe it. You perform your roles with such confidence on stage.
lines.style: Surprised teen tone, slightly higher pitch with genuine disbelief.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔はフィルムの時代でね、撮り直しがきかなくて、長い台詞も一発勝負だったの。
lines.en: Back then it was the film era — no retakes allowed, so even long lines had to land in one shot.
lines.style: Reminiscent and instructive, like sharing precious memory with younger generation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わあ、すごい裏エピソードですね。今度の打ち上げパーティーでもっと聞かせてください。
lines.en: Wow, what an amazing behind-the-scenes story. Please tell me more at the wrap party.
lines.style: Excited youthful enthusiasm, leaning forward with curious sparkle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、いいわよ。でもね、舞台に立つ覚悟だけは、いつでも忘れないでね。
lines.en: Hehe, of course. But never forget the resolve required to stand on stage, dear.
lines.style: Gentle laugh transitioning to serious heartfelt mentor advice, slower delivery.
